design: Hero (desktop/frame-00.png): set the H1 in solid white instead of a gradient fill so it is at least as strong as the subtitle; the gradient text is the lowest-contrast element on the first screen.

Type: replace the single Arial stack with a two-family pairing (a display face for H1/H2, a text face for body) and add a label role (eyebrow or small caps) above each H2 so the scale has three visible levels.

Cards (desktop/frame-01.png): the Our Features cards sit on a grey band in the same tint; either give the cards a white fill or drop the band so the module does not depend on shadow alone, and vary at least one of the three card rows (a two-column feature with an image, or a quote strip) so the same component is not repeated three times.
Icons: replace the seven emoji with a drawn icon set or product screenshots at one consistent size and stroke.
usability: Mobile nav (mobile/frame-00.png): collapse the five links into a menu button below about 768 px, or wrap the row; today 'About' is clipped and 'Contact' is unreachable at 390 px.

Navigation targets: either add Solutions, Pricing, About and Contact sections (or pages) or cut the labels to the sections that exist (Features); add id anchors so the remaining links scroll to their section.
CTA: give 'Get Started Today' and 'Sign Up Now' a visible destination (a form, a pricing section, a sign-up route); the render set shows two buttons and nowhere for them to go.
Add a persistent contact route (email or link) in the footer next to the copyright line.
creativity: Pick one concept tied to the subject ('the future of work'): for example, make the hero the product itself (a live or animated workspace view) instead of a gradient with a slogan, and carry it into the feature cards as cropped views of that same interface.
Replace the star-emoji testimonial cards with one signature module: a single large quote with a photo and a measurable result, or a logo wall of named customers.
Add one considered motion moment (a pinned feature walkthrough or a reveal that explains the product) and nothing else; the manifest shows zero animation of any kind today.
content: Why Choose Us (desktop/frame-01.png): replace the three lorem ipsum bodies with one specific claim each (a latency figure for Fast, a certification for Secure, a capacity or integration count for Powerful).
Testimonials (desktop/frame-02.png): use full names with role and company, quotes that state a problem and an outcome, and drop the 'Amazing!/Love it!/Wow!' headings.
Hero copy: rewrite 'Unlock your potential with our innovative, cutting-edge platform' to say what Nexora is and who it is for in one sentence.
Imagery: add at least one real product image or screenshot per feature; the page currently has zero images and relies on emoji.
